newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Old Mutual, Portugal bank in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Old Mutual, Portugal bank in joint venture.

text.p: South African life assurer Old Mutual has set up a Guernsey-based joint venture financial services company in a deal with Portugal's third largest bank, Grupo Banco Espirito Santo, Old Mutual said on Friday.

The new company, Novos Navegadores, will initially focus on the emigrated Portugese market in South Africa, providing them with investment services and fund management expertise, Old Mutual said in a statement.

The new company will be looking for further expansion opportunities, the two companies said in a separate statement. "As regards further expansion and co-operation in other parts of the world, we undoubtedly will in due course consider such opportunities...," they said.

Novos Navegadores has been set up jointly by Old Mutual subsidiary, Old Mutual International Financial Services and Espirito Santo Activos Financeiros (ESAF), the asset management unit of the Portugese bank.

Based in the Channel Island tax haven of Guernsey, Novos Navegadores will not operate directly from South Africa. Old Mutual representatives will, however, be able to sell some of the new company's products.

Investors' funds will be managed by Old Mutual International Asset Managers, which already oversees assets of over $2.5 billion, in a practical working relationship with ESAF, which manages funds of $4.5 billion.
